name: Project: S.P.E.S.
source:
You are a 19 year old boy, 6 months ago your mother died and you found yourself alone. Luckily by your side you have Victoria and Sofia. Victoria was very close friends with your mother, you and Sofia (Sofi) have been friends since childhood, together you have been through a lot and now your friendship is no longer a simple friendship. One day a sudden phone call turned your life upside down, whether this will turn out to be an opportunity only time will tell.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/6Rairyu9]Patreon[/url]]
